flags.text: Returns NO when startAndReturnError: returned YES but wrote an error object (`!ok || startErr != nil`), contrary to the Cocoa rule that the error out-param is only meaningful on failure; the Pipeline caller then retries start, removes the mic tap and throws audioSessionUnavailable although the engine may be running. Separately, SafeObjC.m is compiled with ARC (CLANG_ENABLE_OBJC_ARC = YES) and without -fobjc-arc-exceptions, so strong objects in each @try scope are not released when an NSException is caught, and the engine is reused after an exception Apple frameworks do not guarantee to recover from (retry at Pipeline:209).
